en.title: Rays race past error-prone Yankees for 2-0 ALDS advantage

en.title: Agriculture Minister Yanao: "Budget handled fairly and appropriately, not based on election results"
en.summary: Japan's Agriculture Minister Yanao apologized for previously stating that national road budget allocations to his home prefecture were drastically cut, and clarified that future budget execution will not be influenced by election outcomes.

en.title: Russia: Plague Research Institute employee dies of pneumonia of unknown cause; "test tube broke" theory circulates, authorities deny
en.summary: A 28-year-old female research assistant at a plague control institute in eastern Siberia died from pneumonia of unclear origin, with speculation linking it to plague infection. Russian authorities dismiss the speculation while the WHO and US monitor the situation.

en.title: Prayers in Lacquer: Lacquer Artist Ishimura Ayumi Supports Disaster-Stricken Wajima Through Her Work
en.summary: Lacquer artist Ishimura Ayumi, 47, encountered the Noto Peninsula earthquake while studying at a lacquer arts technical institute in Wajima. Despite health challenges forcing her early departure, she continues creating works at a local workshop to support the community before leaving the area.

en.title: "Cooking Fires of the People": Reflecting on Emperor Nintoku's Legacy From Above
en.summary: A hot air balloon offering elevated views of Emperor Nintoku's mausoleum in Sakai has operated for one year, reaching over 50,000 visitors despite a 65% operational rate. The wooden torii gate visible from above evokes the ancient emperor's legacy of prioritizing his subjects' welfare.
